== Decklist checked against the scan (2026-10-16) ==
Transcribed from the scanned sheet ([[:File:2008 Worlds Day 2 p104 Michael Raveling DS.png]]). Deck title on the sheet: ''Same As Garrett's Deck, Same as Tom Frafjord's…'' (the sheet has doodles). The old list was a copy of Jesse Reynolds' list; this one is Michael's own sheet. Shield lines 9–11 are Limited Resources, Gravity Shadow and Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us, which are not shields; they are listed under their own card types. Line 33 "(x) Imperial-Class Star Destroyer" is read as (V). Unmarked lines are linked to the Decipher card. Leave Them To Me (V) was not on the sheet.
